_comment: Baseline selector patterns for browser automation. Some entries are English-only starting points; others (such as Outlook) carry multi-language variants. All values are illustrative: verify against the live page before using in a SEL table.

linkedin._post_engagement_anti_pattern: ANTI-PATTERN: these class-keyword selectors return [] on the live LinkedIn analytics page - class names are content-hash-obfuscated (observed: '_04113bfd f9d54e6d'). Do not use. See REFERENCE.md worked examples, LinkedIn Analytics anti-pattern section.
